reading: In the sources reached, one-step Rosenbrock-type formulae with stage parallelism have order 3 or 4 with two to four stages; orders 5 to 7 with full stage parallelism are obtained by two-step peer W-methods, which give up the one-step structure and whose stages are all independent within a step. The repository already contains methods of that family (PPSW1, PTSW2b).

No stiffly accurate order-5(4) one-step ROW tableau with a level structure for two processors was found in this search. The search was short and several full texts were not reachable; this sentence describes the search, it is not a novelty claim.
